static_vignette: A 34-year-old female started amoxicillin-clavulanate 2 days ago for sinusitis. She now has generalized urticaria, lip swelling and a sensation of throat tightness with wheeze that began 30 minutes after her most recent dose. She has a history of hay fever and a childhood rash with penicillin that was never documented. BP 92/58, HR 124, SpO2 91%.
